targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:scenarios" and r._field == "value_dispatch_off_properties_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:dispatch" and r._field == "value_avg_wait_excavator_properties_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:dispatch" and (r._field == "value_tph_crusher_properties_value" or r._field == "value_plan_crusher_tph_properties_value"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.value_plan_crusher_tph_properties_value and r.value_plan_crusher_tph_properties_value > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.value_tph_crusher_properties_value / r.value_plan_crusher_tph_properties_value * 100.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:dispatch" and r._field == "value_fleet_utilization_properties_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Оранжевая линия-ориентир 1,5 мин — «Бозшаколь с диспетчером»; красная 3 мин — «Бозшаколь без диспетчера» (реальные цифры рудника, см. README раздел «Сверка с реальностью»).

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId =~ /^kz\.bozshakol:excavator-/ and r._field == "value_queue_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: strings.trimPrefix(v: r.thingId, prefix: "kz.bozshakol:")}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId =~ /^kz\.bozshakol:truck-/ and r._field == "value_state_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value:
    if r._value == "queued_load" then "ожидает погрузки"
    else if r._value == "loading" then "погрузка"
    else if r._value == "hauling" then "в пути гружёный"
    else if r._value == "queued_dump" then "ожидает разгрузки"
    else if r._value == "dumping" then "разгрузка"
    else if r._value == "returning" then "порожний"
    else if r._value == "down" then "авария"
    else r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["_value"])
  |> count(column: "thingId")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Состояние", thingId: "Самосвалов"})
  |> keep(columns: ["Состояние", "Самосвалов"])

panels.title: Нужно для плана и в резерве

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:dispatch" and (r._field == "value_trucks_needed_properties_value" or r._field == "value_trucks_reserve_properties_value"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: if r._field == "value_trucks_needed_properties_value" then "Нужно для плана" else "В резерве"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:dispatch" and (r._field == "value_time_loading_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_hauling_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_returning_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_queue_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_dumping_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_refueling_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_reserve_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_time_down_pct_properties_value"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: if r._field == "value_time_loading_pct_properties_value" then "погрузка" else if r._field == "value_time_hauling_pct_properties_value" then "гружёный рейс" else if r._field == "value_time_returning_pct_properties_value" then "порожний рейс" else if r._field == "value_time_queue_pct_properties_value" then "очередь" else if r._field == "value_time_dumping_pct_properties_value" then "разгрузка" else if r._field == "value_time_refueling_pct_properties_value" then "заправка" else if r._field == "value_time_reserve_pct_properties_value" then "резерв" else "авария"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
